title: RNA_E01D0
extract_protocol_ch1: BD Vacutainer K2 EDTA tube (10ml) were used for blood collection. We obtained peripheral venous blood samples by venipunction from six participants. And then used Ficoll density gradient centrifugation (TBD, China) to separate PBMCs. We pre-added 4 mL Ficoll to each 15 mL centrifuge tube. For each participant, equal volumes of blood were carefully layered onto Ficoll and centrifuged at 800 g and RT for 25 min (3 acceleration and 1 brake). After centrifugation, we collected PBMCs with pipette into a 15-ml tube, and diluted up to 15 ml with pre-warmed PBS (TBD, China). After centrifuging for 10 min, at 250 g and RT, PBMC were resuspended in 2 mL Red Blood Cell Lysis Buffer (Solarbio, China). After incubating the cells on ice for 10 min, 8 mL PBS was added, gently mixed, and centrifuged at 4℃ 300 g for 10 min. We resuspended the centrifuged cells in 10ml of pre-prepared washing buffer (1× PBS with 0.04% BSA). The cleaning step was performed at 250 g and 4℃ for 10 min. The second time the cells were resuspended by the cleaning buffer and counted with the Dual Fluorescence Cell Counter (LunaTM fl). After centrifugation, the cells were resuspended in the cell cryopreservation system recommended by 10× Genomics. With about 2×106 cells per milliliter, one-milliliter aliquots were gradually frozen in a freezing box over the course of 24 h at -80℃ before being kept in a vapor-phase liquid nitrogen tank.

[scRNA-seq, BCR and TCR] We selected samples before vaccination and at days 7, 14, 37, and 60 after vaccination for scRNA-seq. The cells were first thawed according to the 10× Genomics protocol (Demonstrated Protocol, CG00039). The thawed cells were then stained with trypan blue and placed under a light microscope to observe the cell state and background. The cells were counted using the Dual Fluorescence Cell Counter (LunaTM fl), and subsequent procedures were performed after confirming that the survival rate was not less than 90%. The ChromiumTM Single cell 5’ Reagent Kit, Chromium Single Cell Human BCR Amplification Kit, and Chromium Single Cell Human TCR Amplification Kit of the Chromium platform (10× Genomics, California, USA) were used to create the scRNA-seq and paired single-cell BCR and TCR libraries in accordance with the Chromium Single Cell 5’ Reagent Kits User Guide (v2 Chemistry Dual Index). On the Illumina HiSeq X Ten platform, generated scRNA-seq libraries were sequenced. The preprocessing of the PE150 Illumina sequencing reads was done using the 10× Genomics software CellRanger (version: 6.1.2).

[scATAC-seq] We selected samples for scATAC-seq before vaccination and 60 days after vaccination. The cells after thawing were used in nuclei isolation following the Nuclei Isolation for Single Cell ATAC Sequencing protocol from 10× Genomics. The cells were lysed for 1.5 min during the lysis stage. The nuclei suspension obtained by cell lysis were stained with trypan blue and then observed under a light microscope. As for scRNA-seq, the nuclear suspension was counted with the Dual Fluorescence Cell Counter (LunaTM fl). Then Chromium Single Cell ATAC Library and Gel Bead Kit (10× Genomics, 1000110) were used for scATAC-seq. Nuclear suspensions at sufficient concentrations were then used in library preparation using the 10× Genomics Single Cell ATAC Kits following the manufacturer’s protocol.
